selection: Development exact structured matches, then retained parameter count, then index. Every failed training/payload is reported; original test and reserved authors untouched.
representation: Train-only compact UTF8 word index; shared word/character vectors; five explicit word positions, previous BIO and inferred intent; sentence first/bag/last. Local supervised SGD, no pretrained network, language dictionary meanings or copied training sentences.
collision_control: Same lexical table/coverage/parameters, hash collides known word rows only. Row initialization also changes, so not a clean causal attribution to collisions alone.
scope: Experimental acquisition/representation comparison, not a new invention, general Portuguese, permission to execute tools or complete M1. Vocabulary coverage is not comprehension. Fixed quotas remain unchanged; model scoring including refusals is measured, not RSS/energy.
